subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should OpenClaw adopt capability-aware sender precedence and QQBot's current immediate reconnect retry matcher as permanent delivery behavior?
rationale: The branch is coherent, live-proven, and fully green, but duplicate-registration precedence and durable retry timing are compatibility-sensitive product contracts that automated review cannot choose.

options.title: Accept and land
options.body: Approve both contracts, rebase onto current main, and merge after the refreshed exact head is fully green.

options.title: Narrow immediate replay
options.body: Keep the resolver and reconnect drain while restricting backoff bypass to the exact reported outbound-not-configured and explicit disconnected failures.

options.title: Preserve normal backoff
options.body: Trigger account-scoped drains on READY and RESUMED but let the canonical queue defer every entry according to normal backoff.

recommendation.title: Accept and land
recommendation.body: Approve both contracts, rebase onto current main, and merge after the refreshed exact head is fully green.
